maria_sales: Heads-up: prospect (MedicaCorp) requested an enterprise commit. Traffic: peak 100 rps chat (~750 tokens avg) + 80 rps embeddings (batched). Must be HIPAA-compliant. They want a recommendation: how many reserved GPUs vs burst credits and an autoscale policy.

leo_runtime: Quick questions: chat and embeddings on separate model families? preferred isolation (Dedicated vs Private)?

maria_sales: Chat is a 65B quantized variant, embeddings are 3B. They prefer Dedicated but open to Private if needed for contract.

tara_ops: Ballpark calc: chat 100*750 = 75k tokens/s; embeddings 80*(vector equiv) ~= 100k tokens/s -> ~175k tokens/s total. Conservative per A800 on 65B quantized ~4.5k tokens/s. Naive reserve = ~39 GPUs. But with batching + KV caching we can reduce required reserve.

devon_mlops: Recommend reserve baseline ~24 GPUs ( ~55% sustained ), enable burst pool + autoscale to max 48 GPUs. Enforce embedding batch >= 64 where possible. KV prefix cache + prompt normalization often cuts token work by 25%. Also suggest model-fallback plan: auto-failover to tuned 13B for non-critical bursts.

paul_enterprise: From commercial side, propose 24 reserved + 24 burst credits with a monthly soft cap and defined overage rate. They usually like a capped burst budget.

leo_runtime: Ops checklist: quantized kernels (int8/4), fused attention, reduce max_context to 2048 for chat, enable continuous batching, set autoscale policy: min_replicas=24, max_replicas=48, scale_up_queue_threshold=180, scale_down_idle_minutes=5. Canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 2 hours.

tara_ops: Prewarm plan: run KV warmup with top 50 prompts before go-live. Warmup sample: ```
for p in top_prompts.jsonl; do curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/internal/warmup -d @${p}; done
```

infra-bot: perf-sim job queued by devon_mlops (job id: perf-2026-04-01-09-12)

devon_mlops: Action items: 1) need a 10-minute trace (anonymized) from customer to run perf sim 2) perf numbers -> refine reserve/burst recommendation 3) draft autoscale + fallback runbook. I can start sim as soon as trace uploaded.

maria_sales: I'll ask for a 15k-message sample and permission for a short perf run. ETA customer reply: EOD today. Will post trace here when received. :pray:
